jobs.title: New Grad Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering CPG brands from deduction to production plan. We unify cash application, deductions, disputes, trade promotion management, forecasting, demand planning, and analytics in one integrated platform. The result: measurable time savings, smarter top- and bottom-line decisions, and the speed to scale.

Confido is trusted by 200+ brands managing $20B+ in revenue, including OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, Tropicana, and more.

We’ve achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $15M Series A led by Footwork Ventures and Y Combinator to accelerate our momentum.

The Role

As a Full-Stack Engineer (Early Career) at Confido, you will help build new product features and systems from the ground up. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers to develop AI-powered workflows, scale data systems, and create intuitive product experiences for our customers.

This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is excited to learn quickly, take ownership, and make a real impact on a growing product.

Location:
New York, NY (Relocation supported)

You may be working on

Build and ship product features across the stack with guidance from the team
Contribute to backend systems and data pipelines for financial data processing
Support the development of AI-powered workflows (computer vision + NLP)
Help design user interfaces that simplify complex financial workflows
Collaborate with engineering, product, and occasionally customers to iterate on features
Learn quickly and take on increasing ownership over time

Example Problems

Helping build systems to extract data from financial documents
Supporting efforts to scale data ingestion from multiple sources
Contributing to analytics and forecasting tools for CPG brands
Improving user experiences that turn complex data into actionable insights

Required

What We’re Looking For

Internship, academic project, or equivalent hands-on experience in software engineering
Strong programming fundamentals (any language)
Interest in backend, full-stack, or AI-driven systems
Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and grow quickly

Nice to Have

Exposure to backend development, APIs, or data processing
Familiarity with AI/ML concepts or tools
Strong communication skills and willingness to collaborate
Interest in startups and fast-paced, high-ownership environments
CS degree (or in progress) or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Back End Developer (AI Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if the code you write could directly power the AI systems shaping how millions of people interact with technology? We're looking for Back End Developers based in or around New York to design, build, and optimize the server-side systems and APIs that drive cutting-edge AI products — from data pipelines and model-serving infrastructure to scalable microservices that handle real-world traffic at scale.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Whether you're a seasoned engineer looking for meaningful project work or a strong developer ready to apply your skills to AI-adjacent infrastructure, this is your chance to build things that matter.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design, develop, and maintain robust back end services, APIs, and data pipelines
Build scalable, high-performance server-side architecture to support AI training and inference workloads
Write clean, well-documented, and testable code following engineering best practices
Integrate with databases, message queues, cloud services, and third-party APIs
Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability as usage grows
Collaborate asynchronously with distributed teams of engineers, researchers, and product leads
Troubleshoot production issues, conduct code reviews, and contribute to architectural decisions
Work independently on task-based and project-based assignments on your own schedule

Who You Are

Proficient in one or more back end languages — Python, Go, Java, Node.js, Rust, or similar
Solid understanding of RESTful API design, microservices architecture, and distributed systems
Experienced with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, etc.)
Comfortable working with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
Familiar with version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex systems independently
Self-motivated, reliable, and effective when working asynchronously without close supervision
Clear communicator who can document decisions and collaborate across time zones

Nice to Have

Experience building infrastructure for machine learning or AI systems
Familiarity with data processing frameworks (Apache Kafka, Spark, Airflow, or similar)
Background in performance optimization, caching strategies, or high-throughput systems
Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
Experience with serverless architectures or event-driven design patterns
Contributions to open-source projects or a strong portfolio of personal/professional work

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — set your own hours and work from anywhere
Freelance autonomy with access to meaningful, technically challenging work
Build systems at the intersection of software engineering and artificial intelligence
Collaborate with a global network of talented engineers and researchers
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE: This position is not C2C/ 3rd party eligible.

We are seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to build and support interoperability solutions connecting clinical and business systems. This role develops, implements, and maintains interfaces and middleware to ensure secure, reliable data exchange across healthcare platforms.
Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain system integrations and interfaces
Support Epic Bridges, Corepoint interface engine, GoAnywhere MFT, and related tools
Perform data mapping, interface configuration, and code development
Troubleshoot integration issues and support application teams and vendors
Document integration standards and improve interface performance

Required Skills
HL7, FHIR, CCDA
REST/SOAP APIs & web services
XML, EDI, FTP, TCP/IP
Interface engine administration & Microsoft SQL

Preferred
Epic Bridges and healthcare interoperability experience
Care Everywhere backend configuration (minor role component)

Qualifications
High school diploma required; degree preferred
Healthcare IT experience preferred

jobs.title: Software Engineer - 175793
jobs.description:
Zachary Piper Solutions is seeking an experienced Software Engineer
to support a leading aerospace and defense organization delivering advanced command-and-control capabilities for a mission-critical U.S. government defense program. This role is fully onsite in Colorado Springs, CO (NO FLEXIBILITY) and requires an active Top Secret clearance w/ SCI eligibility*

The Software Engineer
will lead the design, development, integration, and sustainment of mission-critical software supporting space systems, ground segments, Command & Control (C2), mission planning, and real-time data processing
. This role will drive full-lifecycle software development across API/backend architecture, front-end and geospatial applications, and Agile/DevSecOps environments
, while providing technical leadership and ensuring solutions meet performance, security, quality, and customer requirements.

Responsibilities of the Software Enginee
r:

Lead full-lifecycle development of mission-critical software supporting space systems, ground segments, C2, mission planning, and real-time data processing, from requirements and architecture through deployment and sustainment.
Architect and develop high-performance APIs, backend services, and system integrations connecting front-end and backend applications, with an emphasis on automation, security, reliability, and performance.
Lead Agile/DevSecOps development and integration utilizing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, builds, and deployment workflows.
Develop modern, intuitive front-end applications and real-time 2D/3D geospatial visualizations, translating UI/UX designs into functional software.
Lead code reviews, troubleshooting, testing, and performance optimization while driving software quality, security, development standards, and process improvements.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship across engineering teams, including R&D efforts, emerging technology implementation, and software/supplier performance.

Qualifications for the
Software Engineer:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of software development supporting space/ground systems, including C2, mission planning, and real-time data processing.
5+ years of Python and 3+ years of JavaScript (Angular/JQuery), TypeScript, Java, and FastAPI development.
5+ years of full SDLC experience, including requirements, design, development, integration, testing, and deployment.
5+ years developing real-time 2D/3D geospatial UIs and working with PostgreSQL and SQL/NoSQL databases.
5+ years of software leadership on government programs, including Agile/DevSecOps environments and technical mentorship.
Experience with API/backend architecture, CI/CD, automated testing/builds/deployments, and secure software development.
Strong knowledge of C2, mission planning, ground systems, and mission-critical real-time applications; ability to obtain required program suitability.
Active Top Secret (w/ SCI eligibility) or active TS/SCI clearance*
IAT Level II certification (Sec+, CCNA, CySA+, etc...)
Ability & Willingness to work fully onsite in Colorado Springs, CO.

Compensation for the
Software Engineer:

Salary Range: $170,000 - $210,000 *depending on experience*
Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k Plan, PTO, Holidays, Sick Leave if required by law

This job opens for applications on 09/21. Applications for this job will be accepted for at least 30 days from the posting date.
